summary: AbbVie Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $10 billion senior notes offering across nine tranches, with proceeds intended to partially fund its acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics and for general corporate purposes. The notes are unsecured, unlisted, and subject to a special mandatory redemption at 101% if the Apogee acquisition is terminated before closing. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special-situation event itself; the acquisition is referenced but not the subject of this filing. No special situation category applies; the filing is an ordinary shelf takedown.
